warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window). The top row has a fourth, empty panel (no mark, no data) — nothing recorded for it.
Doors: two widths printed (0.90 / 0.80, 0.80 / 0.70) — the outer one is the frame (width_m), the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m). Every head height is printed against ระดับพื้นห้อง.

Windows: sill + window = head (น1 0.45 + 1.60 = 2.05; น2/น3 0.95 + 1.10 = 2.05; น4 1.65 + 0.50 = 2.15) — all chains close. The material is printed อลูมิเนียมมอบขาว on every window and is kept verbatim.
